plugins.description: Codex-style Windows computer use for DeepSeek Harness: UI Automation + screenshots + SendInput, liquid-glass screen overlay, ESC kill switch. Install: dsh plugin --profile web add github:esch30636/dsh-computer-use
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-computer-use

[![GitHub release](https://img.shields.io/github/v/release/esch30636/dsh-computer-use?sort=semver)](https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)
[![dsh-plugin](https://img.shields.io/badge/topic-dsh--plugin-4B5563)](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin)

Codex-style **Windows computer use** for DeepSeek Harness: window-targeted UI Automation + occlusion-tolerant screenshots + SendInput mouse/keyboard injection, exposed as five model-facing tools and backed by a bundled long-lived PowerShell helper.

While computer use is active, a click-through **screen overlay** draws a vivid "liquid glass" look: a sapphire *edge vignette* (fully clear center, satin-navy darkening toward the four screen edges) with a thin cyan glass rim hugging the display border, plus a "dynamic island" status pill at the top center — sapphire gradient, diagonal sheen, bright rim, breathing blue glow: `DeepSeek Harness 正在操控你的电脑 | 按 ESC 终止`. Pressing **ESC** stops computer use immediately and closes the overlay; the agent is told to stop and reports back.

Designed after the OpenAI Codex Windows Computer Use surface (`list_apps` / `get_window_state` / `click(element_index | x,y)` / `press_key` / `type_text` / `scroll` / `drag` / `set_value` / `activate_window`, X11-keysym-style key names, one action then re-observe), reimplemented as a pure DSH plugin with no third-party runtime dependencies.

## What you get

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `computer_list_windows` | List targetable top-level windows (window_id, process identity, title, rect, foreground/minimized, policy-blocked flag). Optionally lists Start-menu launchable apps. |
| `computer_observe` | Capture one window state: screenshot (default) and/or UI Automation tree with element indexes, focused element, selection, document text. Returns `state_id` + screenshot coordinate mapping. |
| `computer_action` | Exactly one action against a state: click / double_click / right_click / middle_click / mouse_move / type / key / scroll / drag / set_value / wait / activate_window. |
| `computer_launch_app` | Launch by exe path, exe name, Start-menu display name, `.lnk`, or `shell:AppsFolder\<AUMID>`; reports the windows it opened. |
| `computer_sequence` | Run up to 100 ordered input steps on one window without re-observing between them (absolute screen pixels) — for repetitive GUI work such as drawing a diagram; optionally returns one verification screenshot. |

Plus the click-through status overlay with the **ESC kill switch** (`USER_ESCAPE`), a system-prompt section (workflow, hard denies, confirmation policy) and a `computer-use` skill with the full playbook.

## Requirements

- Windows 10/11, interactive user session (not a service session), PowerShell 5.1 (`powershell.exe` — pwsh 7 not required).
- DSH 0.2.x (web/desktop profile; any composition that mounts `tools`, `systemPrompt` and `attachments` — the shipped base mounts all three).
- No native modules, no npm dependencies, no MCP server.

## Install

### Option A — DSH CLI (`dsh plugin add`)

For profiles the `dsh` CLI can manage (`web`, `tui`, `headless`, …), the plugin
installs as a regular DSH bundle:

```sh
# straight from GitHub (pnpm fetches the repo tarball)
dsh plugin --profile web add github:esch30636/dsh-computer-use

# or from the release tarball (no git fetch; works behind a GitHub proxy too)
dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases/latest/download/dsh-computer-use.tgz"
```

`dsh plugin` installs the package into the profile and enables its bundle.
Restart the host (or let HMR recompose) and the `computer_*` tools appear in a
new session.

### Option B — Desktop app (`desktop` profile)

The Desktop app owns its reserved `desktop` profile, so `dsh plugin --profile
desktop` deliberately refuses to run there. Two supported paths:

1. **Plugin market** — after this plugin is listed in
   [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com) (submission pending the
   one-day repository age rule), open **设置 → 插件市场** and install it with one
   click.
2. **Release installer** (works immediately, no git/pnpm needed): download and
   unzip the archive from
   [releases](https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases), then run
   inside the unzipped folder:

   ```powershell
   # downloads the latest release tarball and installs into the desktop profile
   powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install-release.ps1
   ```

   Pin a version with `-Version v1.1.0`; target another profile with
   `-Profile web`; add `-Verify` to run the offline composition dump afterwards.

### Option C — manual / fully offline

Download the release archive
([releases](https://github.com/esch30636/dsh-computer-use/releases)), unzip it,
then run the bundled installer:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1 -Profile desktop
```

The installer copies the package to `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/dsh-computer-use`, appends `dsh-computer-use` to `dsh.profile.bundles` (backing up `package.json`), and installs the skill to `%USERPROFILE%\.agents\skills\computer-use`. It works for any profile, e.g. `-Profile cu-test`, and `-Verify` dumps the composed profile offline.

Uninstall:

```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1 -Profile desktop -Uninstall
```

> **Note on the package name:** an unrelated npm package already uses the name
> `dsh-computer-use`, so `dsh plugin add dsh-computer-use` would install that one.
> Install this plugin through the GitHub spec or the release tarball URL shown
> above. Windows-only (`os: win32`): the helper drives a real interactive desktop
> session via UI Automation + SendInput.

## Configure

Options go in the profile's `cordis.patch.yml` (the row id is `computer-use`):

```yaml
- id: computer-use
  config:
    # extra process names/paths to deny (built-in denies always stay unless an
    # allow-* escape hatch is enabled)
    blockedProcesses: [msedge.exe]
    # allowlist mode: only these processes may be automated
    # allowedProcesses: [notepad.exe, mspaint.exe]
    screenshotMaxWidth: 1600
    screenshotMaxHeight: 1200
    maxElements: 600
    maxTreeDepth: 12
    idleTimeoutMs: 600000
    startupTimeoutMs: 90000
    requestTimeoutMs: 30000
    confirmRiskyActions: true
    warnWhenApprovalUnavailable: true
    allowWindowsKey: false
    allowTerminalAutomation: false
    keepScreenshots: false
    # screen overlay + ESC kill switch
    overlayEnabled: true
    overlayMessage: "DeepSeek Harness 正在操控你的电脑　|　按 ESC 终止"
    overlayIdleTimeoutMs: 90000
    overlayEdgeOpacity: 55
```

| Option | Default | Meaning |
|---|---|---|
| `helperPath` | bundled | Override the helper script path. |
| `powershellPath` | `powershell.exe` | PowerShell used to host the helper. |
| `idleTimeoutMs` | `600000` | Kill the idle helper; it restarts on the next call. |
| `startupTimeoutMs` | `90000` | First-call budget (PowerShell start + Add-Type compile). |
| `requestTimeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-request budget once warm (screenshots/UIA use longer internal budgets). |
| `screenshotMaxWidth` / `screenshotMaxHeight` | `1600` / `1200` | Helper-side downscale bounds before the attachment store. |
| `maxElements` / `maxTreeDepth` / `maxTextChars` | `600` / `12` / `20000` | Accessibility tree bounds. |
| `blockedProcesses` / `blockedWindowClasses` | `[]` | Extra denials added to the built-in list. |
| `allowedProcesses` | `[]` | When non-empty: allowlist mode (everything else is denied). |
| `keepScreenshots` | `false` | Keep captured PNGs in `%TEMP%\dsh-computer-use` for debugging. |
| `confirmRiskyActions` | `true` | Ask through `ctx.approval` before destructive/externally visible actions. |
| `warnWhenApprovalUnavailable` | `true` | Under approval policy `never`/no channel: continue with a WARNING instead of failing. Set false for fail-closed. |
| `allowWindowsKey` / `allowTerminalAutomation` | `false` | Escape hatches for the two most dangerous hard denies (still discouraged; the helper keeps its own che

plugins.description: SVG Studio for DeepSeek Harness: image + prompt to a pure, layered SVG. Personal, non-commercial use only; commercial licensing on request. By xiangwriter.
plugins.readme_text:
SVG Studio

Image + prompt → pure, layered SVG.
A local-first vectorization studio for DeepSeek Harness.
Built and maintained by xiangwriter.

dsh-xiangwriter-svg-studio

简体中文 · Install · Usage · Engine · Development · License

> **Personal, non-commercial use only.** > This repository is source-available, not open-source. Commercial use of any kind > requires a separate written licence from xiangwriter; see [COMMERCIAL.md](COMMERCIAL.md). > The `xiangwriter` name, mark and branding must remain intact. --- SVG Studio turns a character illustration, sticker or flat-colour image into a **real SVG made of paths, gradients and masks** — no embedded bitmap, no external tracing service. It ships as three things in one DeepSeek Harness plugin: - a full **Web Studio** page in the Harness sidebar, - an agent tool, **`svg_studio`**, for file-path workflows, - a reusable agent skill, **`svg-vector-recreation`**. Everything runs locally. Images and prompts go only to the local Harness server and the local Python engine. ## Why it exists Most image-to-SVG tools either return one giant traced path, or quietly embed the source PNG inside an SVG. SVG Studio is built for character art: it keeps the figure, refines the face locally, builds a clean backdrop, and validates that the result is genuinely vector. The original illustration is never included in this repository; the plugin contains code and synthetic test fixtures only. ## Highlights - **Prompt-guided presets.** Write what you want in natural language (“keep the wine-red backdrop, clean up the contour, more detail in the eyes”) and the engine maps those notes to colour counts, face detail and backdrop settings. Explicit overrides always win. - **Layered colour tracing.** Median-cut palette → connected colour regions → closed contours with even-odd holes → optional RDP simplification. A single colour can contain many islands. - **A figure-aware clip.** The engine samples the backdrop, separates it from the figure, handles interior holes and near-white areas, then pre-clips colour paths to the character. Background noise and stray colour blobs are less likely to become paths. - **Local face-detail pass.** A small, soft-masked palette refines eyes, cheeks, mouth and hair details without changing the rest of the image. - **Clean backdrops without invented effects.** The default `gradient` backdrop is a clean gradient derived from the source border. It does **not** add a synthetic halo or dark ring. Choose `original` to keep the source background. - **Outline is opt-in.** The extra dark outer contour is **off by default**. Turn it on in Advanced settings only when you want a sticker-like rim. - **Small, inspectable output.** Paths, gradients, a soft face mask, and no `` or `data:image` payloads. A structural check rejects malformed SVG. - **Bounded work.** Long edges above 1200 px are scaled down; the engine warns when an output gets large. Typical 240 px chibi art completes in under two seconds. - **English and Chinese UI**, with locale files you can extend. ## Install Requires a DeepSeek Harness profile with the Web UI and a Python 3.10+ interpreter with **Pillow** and **numpy**. 1. Install the plugin from GitHub: ```bash dsh plugin add github:xiangwriter-dev/dsh-xiangwriter-svg-studio ``` Or from a local checkout: ```bash dsh plugin add /absolute/path/to/dsh-xiangwriter-svg-studio ``` 2. Install the Python engine dependencies into the interpreter DSH can see: ```bash python -m pip install -r engine/requirements.txt ``` On Windows, DSH also detects its bundled Python runtime and `DSH_SVG_STUDIO_PYTHON` if set. The Studio page shows **Local engine ready** when Pillow and numpy are available. 3. Refresh the Harness Web UI. The sidebar entry **SVG Studio / SVG 矢量化** opens the Studio. The plugin is a bundle with a Host half (`index.js`), a Web client (`client.js`), a Cordis patch, locale metadata and the Python engine. ## Use it ### In the Web Studio 1. Drop a PNG, JPG, WebP or GIF, or click to choose one. Images are normalised to a maximum 1200 px long edge and flattened onto white before upload. 2. Optional: write a short direction in **Your ideas and direction**. 3. Pick a preset (or open **Advanced settings**). 4. Press **Generate SVG**. Preview, download, copy the code, or open the SVG in a new tab. ### From an agent Ask in natural language; the skill is selected automatically when the task matches it: ```text Use svg_studio on D:\art\character.png. Preset: faithful. Keep face detail on, outer contour off, clean gradient background. Save the SVG next to the source. ``` Or call the tool directly. Common arguments: | Argument | Values | Notes | | --- | --- | --- | | `image_path` | local path | PNG / JPEG / WebP / GIF | | `prompt` | free text | Stored in the SVG description; guides settings | | `preset` | `faithful`, `clean`, `flat`, `original`, `mini` | Defaults to `faithful` | | `colors` | 24–224 | Overrides the preset palette size | | `face_detail` | boolean | Local face pass | | `outline` | boolean | Extra outer rim, off by default | | `background` | `auto`, `gradient`, `original` | Clean gradient, auto, or source backdrop | | `saturation`, `contrast` | numbers | Small colour adjustments | | `output_path` | local path | Optional destination for the `.svg` | ### Presets | Preset | Palette | Face pass | Backdrop | Best for | | --- | ---: | :---: | --- | --- | | `faithful` | 160 | on | clean gradient | closest overall recreation | | `clean` | 112 | on | clean gradient | smaller, flatter, tidier files | | `flat` | 72 | off | clean gradient | poster-like colour masses | | `original` | 140 | on | source backdrop | scenes, photos, or when the backdrop is part of the art | | `mini` | 64 | off | clean gradient | very simple art and tiny files | The outer contour is independent of the preset and is **off by default**. ## Output contract - The SVG contains ``, ``, ``, ``, `` and a `` — no raster image. - The output is XML-validated; ``, `data:image`, and base64 payloads are rejected. - Generated files are stored under `$DSH_HOME/svg-studio/outputs/` and pruned to the newest 40. - The result is a local file; nothing is uploaded to a cloud service. ## Local API The Studio talks to three exact, local-only routes served by the Host plugin: | Method | Route | Purpose | | --- | --- | --- | | `GET` | `/svg-studio/api/health` | Python, Pillow and numpy availability | | `POST` | `/svg-studio/api/generate` | data-URL or file-path generation | | `GET` | `/svg-studio/file?name=.svg` | serve a saved output from the output directory | These routes are registered on the local Harness web server and are not intended to be exposed publicly. ## How the engine works ```text source image │ normalize / flatten ▼ adaptive palette

plugins.description: A quieter way to keep moving. State-aware next-instruction drafts for DeepSeek DSH. 下一步，自然发生。
plugins.readme_text:
English · 简体中文

![Next instruction suggestions. A quieter way to keep moving.](docs/readme/cover.png)

Download · Get started · Under the hood · MIT license

# Next instruction suggestions **The next step, without breaking your flow.** A small, considered plugin for **DeepSeek DSH**. When an assistant finishes a turn, it offers up to three concrete next instructions above the composer. Choose one, refine it, and send it when you are ready. Suggestions are optional. **A click fills your draft; it never sends a message or runs an action.** --- ### Less friction. More intention. | A little help | A clear boundary | | :--- | :--- | | **Relevant next steps** | Uses recent conversation text, open todos, tool outcomes, changed files, and the assistant's open question to propose short, concrete instructions. | | **Your words, your decision** | One click fills the composer and returns focus. Edit before sending. | | **Quiet by design** | Hides as you type, open the command menu, change sessions, or press Escape in the composer. Results arriving after 1.5 seconds are discarded. | | **A lighter model preference** | Auto mode favors names such as `flash`, `mini`, and `lite`. This is a naming heuristic, not a live price comparison. | | **Small, explicit context** | Sends limited text and tool names/targets—not tool outputs—to a provider configured in DSH, with common secret patterns and path usernames redacted. | ![Illustrative suggestion dock and composer with example content.](docs/readme/preview.png)

Illustrative interface with example content. Actual appearance follows your DSH theme.

### A simple rhythm 1. **Finish a turn.** Leave the composer empty after the assistant responds. 2. **Choose a direction.** Pick a suggestion, or dismiss it with `×`. 3. **Make it yours.** Review the draft, edit freely, and send it yourself. The plugin waits for at least two user turns. Thin context or greetings may produce no suggestions. Dismissed suggestions are filtered in page memory, capped at 20 entries per session across 50 tracked browser sessions. ### Why the next step is concrete The host keeps a compact state packet for the completed turn: recent tool calls and results (name, target, success/failure), changed files, running or recent jobs, active goal/plan, open todos, and the assistant's open question. It does not separately load full tool outputs, attachment bodies, or file contents into the prompt. The model is asked for up to five candidates. A local ranker then selects at most three by grounding (a file, test, command, or function named in the state), fit to the assistant's question, a state prior (for example, favor commit after a completed run with changes; favor fixes after a failed action), and intent diversity (change / verify / inspect / ship). This can make suggestions shorter and more specific than a generic "continue". ## Getting started **Requirements:** Node.js **22.19 or later**, DeepSeek DSH **`>=0.2.1-rc.2 <0.3.0`**, a Web GUI or Desktop client, and a configured model provider. The original development baseline was DSH `0.2.1-rc.2`; the full range has not been tested against every release. ### Install the release package 1. Open the [latest release](https://github.com/Jul11us/dsh-next-suggestion/releases/latest) and copy the `.tgz` asset URL. 2. In DSH, open **Plugins → Add plugin / Install third-party plugin** and enter the `.tgz` download URL in the package field. 3. Enable **Next instruction suggestions**, restart DSH, then refresh the client. If your installer does not accept an archive URL, extract the archive and install the inner `package` directory as a local plugin. ### Install from source ```sh git clone https://github.com/Jul11us/dsh-next-suggestion.git cd dsh-next-suggestion npm ci --ignore-scripts ``` Add the cloned directory through DSH's local plugin installer, enable the bundle, restart DSH, and refresh the client. A desktop-profile CLI alternative is: ```text dsh plugin --profile desktop add "file:C:\path\to\dsh-next-suggestion" ``` This version is distributed through GitHub Release. These installation methods do not require an npm registry publication. ## Tune the experience Open **Plugins → Next instruction suggestions → Configure**, or **Settings → Next suggestions**. | Setting | Default | Purpose | | :--- | :--- | :--- | | Enable predictions | On | Turning this off stops new prediction calls. | | Candidates | `3` | Show between one and three suggestions. | | Provider / model | Empty | Auto-select a route, or specify your preferred provider and model. | | Host timeout | `8000 ms` | Bound the host request; the interface still has a 1.5-second display window. | | Debug details | Off | Show token counts, latency, and call count. | Automatic routing prefers models with lightweight names. When it falls back to a reasoning or expensive-looking model, it allows at most one prediction per tracked session. A provider-only setting stays within that provider; a model-only setting resolves that exact model. Choosing both overrides automatic routing. Prediction calls can consume provider credits. ## Context, with limits The plugin may send the session title, up to six open todos, up to six recent user/assistant turns, and a compact state packet (tool names and targets, success/failure, changed file paths, job labels, active goal/plan, and the assistant's open question) to your configured provider. It does **not separately load** tool output bodies, attachment bodies, or file contents into the prompt. Assistant prose is shortened and fenced code blocks are replaced with `[code]`. User messages, shell command text, goals, or todo labels can still contain pasted code or sensitive material. Common API-key/token patterns, bearer strings, long base64 content, and usernames in common home-directory paths are redacted before the request. **Redaction is best effort; it cannot recognize every secret or personal detail.** Review the provider you select and the conversation you use it with. The plugin does not separately read file contents, attachment bodies, or tool-output bodies into its prompt. It adds no analytics endpoint and does not write prediction context to disk. In-memory state is cleared on reload or host restart as appropriate; DSH and your provider have their own storage behavior. ## Built to be understood Two small JavaScript modules, public DSH extension points, and no build step. The host tracks turns and prepares model calls; the client renders suggestions and edits the draft. No core patches are required. - [Architecture and extension points](docs/ARCHITECTURE.md) - [Publishing guide](PUBLISHING.md) - [Host tests](https://github.com/Jul11us/dsh-next-suggestion/blob/main/test/host.test.mjs) · [Client tests](https://github.com/Jul11us/dsh-next-suggestion/blob/main/test/client.test.mjs) ```sh npm ci --ignore-scripts npm test npm pack --dry-run # inspect the prompt of a replay case without spending tokens node scripts/eval-replay.mjs --dry-run ``` The commands above run from a source checkout. Optional replay evaluation with your own provider (PowerShell): ```powershell # score top-1/top-3 against the message that actually followed a turn node scripts/export-golden.mjs "C:\path\to\session.v4.jsonl.zstd" scripts/golden/session.json $env:EVAL_BASE_URL="https://api.deepseek.com" $env:EVAL_API_KEY="..." $env:EVAL_MODEL="deepseek-chat" node scripts/eval-replay.mjs --cases scripts/golden/session.json ``` `npm test` covers 28 host checks and 8 client checks, including the state packet, grounding/diversity ranking, open-question code filtering, job-failure ordering, timeout, cancellation, and the actual host response rendered by the client. The replay harness uses the shipped prompt, parser, and ranker; keep exported session cases out of git (they contain private conversation text). These checks do not certif

plugins.description: Ordered web-search failover provider for DeepSeek Harness: try backends in priority order, fall back automatically.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-web-search-failover

DeepSeek Harness 的搜索故障转移插件：按顺序尝试多个搜索后端，前一个失败（HTTP 错误、没有 `web_search_tool_result` 结果块、或返回空结果）时自动落到下一个。

> **English.** A failover web-search provider for DeepSeek Harness. The harness resolves exactly one search provider per `ctx.web` seam and a provider carries a single `model`, so one upstream error kills the whole search. This bundle registers a `deepseek-failover` provider that walks an ordered list of backends — same request, next backend on any failure (throw, abort excepted, or an empty result) — and only fails when every backend did. The stock `web-search-deepseek` row is disabled by the bundle's own patch, so no manual profile editing is needed. Node ≥ 22, harness ≥ 0.2.1, MIT.

## 为什么需要它

Harness 的 `ctx.web` 每次只解析一个 search provider，provider 也只有单个 `model` 字段，没有失败重试链；`web-search-deepseek` 一旦上游出错，整次搜索就失败。new-api 的自动换渠道只在“同一个模型名有多个渠道”时生效，所以要么在网关造一个别名，要么在 harness 侧做转移。本插件选后者：网关保持官方模型名。

## 兼容性

| 平台 | 支持 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| Windows 10/11（PowerShell 7 或 5.1） | ✅ | `dsh plugin` 本身跨平台；本文所有命令在 PowerShell 里原样可跑 |
| macOS（zsh / bash） | ✅ | 原生路径 |
| Linux | ✅ | 原生路径 |

前置条件：

- **DSH ≥ 0.2.1** — 插件复用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek` 导出的 `DeepSeekSearchProvider`，0.2.0 没有这个接口
- **Node ≥ 22**，且 **`pnpm` 在 `PATH` 上**（`dsh plugin` 内部调 pnpm）
- 能访问 `https://codeload.github.com`（public 仓库，不需要 token）
- 一个 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容的搜索网关，以及它的 API key

## 安装

一条命令（自动写依赖、写 `dsh.profile.bundles`、并跑 `pnpm install`）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover
```

```powershell
# Windows 上完全一样
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover
```

然后**重启 DSH**（关掉 `dsh web` 的终端再重新起）。插件是在 host 启动时 import 的，不重启不会生效 —— 详见排错第 1 条。

Desktop 版 profile 名是 `desktop`，需要先**完全退出应用**再加：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile desktop add github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover
```

插件没有 `prepare` 脚本、没有构建步骤，纯 JS，不会触发 pnpm 的 `allowBuilds` 拦截。

### 凭据

插件的 `apiKeyEnv` 指向一个**凭据引用名**，不是明文。把网关令牌写进 harness 的凭据文件：

- macOS / Linux：`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`
- Windows：`%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\.credentials.yaml`

```yaml
refs:
  NEWAPI_API_KEY: sk-...
```

这个文件由 harness 的 credentials 插件注入，**不需要写系统环境变量**。如果你更习惯环境变量，把 `apiKeyEnv` 改成对应的变量名即可。

### 不想用 CLI 时

手工改 profile 的 `package.json` 效果一样：

```jsonc
"dependencies": {
  "dsh-web-search-failover": "github:xingzoudefengye/dsh-web-search-failover"
},
"dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [ "...", "dsh-web-search-failover" ] } }
```

再在 profile 目录（如 `~/.dsh/profiles/web`，Windows 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\web`）跑 `pnpm install`，重启 DSH。

## 验证

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A3 "searchProvider"
```

```powershell
dsh --profile web --dump-config | Select-String -Pattern "searchProvider" -Context 0,3
```

应看到 `searchProvider: deepseek-failover`。再做一次真实搜索，网关日志里会出现主后端的模型名；只有主后端失败时才会多一条备用后端。

**关于默认网关地址**：插件自带的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里 `baseURL` 写的是一个示例网关（`http://43.133.21.227:3000/v1`）。用别人的地址跑不通，**请改成你自己的网关**，见下一节。

## 配置

在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里覆盖 `id: web-search-failover` 这一行的 `config`（插件自带的默认顺序是 `deepseek-v4-flash` → `claude-haiku-5-5`，不覆盖就按这个走）：

```yaml
- id: web-search-failover
  config:
    providerId: deepseek-failover   # ctx.web 选中的 provider 名，一般不用改
    backends:
      - { model: deepseek-v4-flash,  baseURL: https://your-gateway/v1, apiKeyEnv: NEWAPI_API_KEY }
      - { model: claude-haiku-5-5,   baseURL: https://your-gateway/v1, apiKeyEnv: NEWAPI_API_KEY }
```

| 键 | 默认 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|
| `providerId` | `deepseek-failover` | 注册给 `ctx.web` 的 provider 名；bundle patch 里 `web.searchProvider` 必须与它一致 |
| `backends` | — | **有序**列表，第 0 个优先，其后都是备胎；每项 `model` / `baseURL` / `apiKeyEnv` 各自独立 |
| `apiKeyEnv` / `baseURL` / `apiKey` / `apiVersion` / `maxTokens` / `maxUses` | 见 `lib/index.js` 的 `Config` | 旧式单后端字段；用 `backends` 时不需要，插件按 backend 逐个构造 provider |

失败判定：抛错、或者成功但没有 sources。`WEB_ABORTED`（用户取消）直接向上抛，不换后端 —— 取消不该触发备用后端。全部失败才返回最后一个错误；如果所有后端都成功但确实没结果，返回那个空结果。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-search-failover
```

然后重启 DSH。bundle 的 patch 随之失效，harness 原有的 `web-search-deepseek` 行会恢复；如果你之前手工在 profile patch 里删过它，需要自己加回来。

## 排错

| 现象 | 原因 | 处理 |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh plugin add` 成功，但搜索行为没变 | 插件在 host 进程启动时 import，进程里的模块不会热替换 | 重启 DSH（关掉 `dsh web` 再起） |
| 改了插件源码（哪怕是 `lib/index.js`）也不生效 | Node 的 ESM 缓存：已 import 的模块不会重新执行 | 同上，重启 host；GitHub 安装还需先 `dsh plugin add` 重装以拉新代码 |
| `dsh plugin add` 卡住或报网络错误 | 拉的是 `codeload.github.com` 的 tarball，公司网络/代理常拦 | 走代理，或把仓库整目录拷过去，依赖改成 `file:` 路径后 `pnpm install`（插件无外部 npm 依赖，离线可装） |
| 报 `WEB_PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE` | 所有 backends 都 `available() === false`，通常是 `apiKeyEnv` 指向的引用没有值 | 检查 `.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs:` 里有该键，且键名与 `apiKeyEnv` 完全一致 |
| 搜索一直是备用后端的模型 | 主后端失败但未报错（返回空结果也会触发回落） | 看网关日志确认主后端返回码；密钥额度、模型名拼写是最常见原因 |
| 配置树里出现同一个 row id 冲突（`web-search-deepseek` 被两处同时声明） | profile patch 里手工加过 `id: web-search-deepseek` 的行，与 bundle patch 打架 | 删掉 profile 里那一行，插件自带的 patch 已负责禁用它 |

## 同步到另一台机器

逻辑全在插件里，换机器不需要搬配置，但要满足四件事：

1. **装插件**：跑上面那条 `dsh plugin add`。版本自动跟 `master` 最新提交，两台机器不必同 commit，但 harness 版本要一致（都 ≥ 0.2.1）。
2. **凭据**：`.credentials.yaml` 的 `refs:` 里要有 `NEWAPI_API_KEY`。
3. **清掉旧的 provider 行**：profile patch 里若还有 `- id: web-search-deepseek`，删掉。
4. **网关可达**：`baseURL` 换成本机可访问的地址。

## 开发

本仓库是纯 JS、无构建步骤。仓库里没有 `node_modules`，直接 `npm test` 会因为找不到 `@deepseek-ai/*` 的 peer 依赖而失败 —— 先把本机已安装的 harness 包链进来：

```bash
node scripts/dev-link.mjs            # 探测 dsh 的安装位置，链入 schemastery / dsh-web / dsh-web-search-deepseek 等
npm test                             # node --test
```

`dev-link` 依次探测：`dsh` 可执行文件所在的 npm 目录、`$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>`、`$DSH_HOME/profiles`、`$DSH_HOME`，也可以用第一个参数或 `DSH_PACKAGE_DIR` 直接指定 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 所在目录。Windows 上用 junction，不需要管理员权限。

改完代码在本地验证，再装到 profile：`dsh plugin --profile web add <本仓库绝对路径>` 走 `link:` 依赖，配合 `dev-link` 即可改完重启 host 就看到效果。

## 相关插件

同作者、同一套安装方式（`dsh plugin add github:xingzoudefengye/<repo>`）：

- [dsh-browser](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-browser) — 给 agent 一个可驱动的真实浏览器，侧栏并排显示
- [dsh-compaction-local-handoff](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-compaction-local-handoff) — 无模型的本地交接式压缩
- [dsh-project-memory](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-project-memory) — 有界、可提交进 git 的项目记忆
- [dsh-resume-budget](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-resume-budget) — 会话恢复时的输入预算控制
- [dsh-session-recall](https://github.com/xingzoudefengye/dsh-session-recall) — 无模型、有界的会话史书

## 许可

MIT © xingzoudefengye，见 [LICENSE](LICENSE)。

plugins.description: DeepSeek 官方 API 峰谷价格提醒：Harness Web UI 胶囊 + deepseek_price_tip Agent 工具
plugins.readme_text: # DeepSeek 价格峰谷提醒 [![Listed on dsh-plugin.org](https://dsh-plugin.org/badges/listed.svg)](https://dsh-plugin.org/plugins/jaaaa34/dsh-deepseek-price-tip) --- 在 Harness Web UI 的输入框下方显示一个小胶囊，提醒你 DeepSeek 官方 API 当前处于 **峰价** 还是 **谷价**，以及距离下次切换还有多久。点开胶囊可以查看当前价目表（人民币）、峰时规则、数据来源和抓取时间，并可从官网重新抓取。 胶囊样式和原生胶囊（会话统计、Token 用量、上下文用量）保持一致。 使用 DeepSeek Harness 的创造模式完成。 ## 功能 - **实时读数**：按官网规则计算当前时段（北京时间 09:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，周一至周五，不含中国法定节假日），并倒计时到下一次切换。 - **人民币价目表**：读取官方中文定价页，显示模型、档位、缓存命中/未命中输入价、输出价，峰/谷两档同时列出，当前生效的一档高亮。 - **从官网更新**：面板里的“立即更新”会读取 ，同时更新价格和峰谷时段规则（时间窗口、星期、是否排除节假日）。 - **自动更新**：启动时以及之后每 30 分钟检查一次，缓存超过 `autoRefreshHours` 小时就在后台重新抓取。抓取失败时保留旧表，并在面板里报告原因。 - **Agent 工具**：`deepseek_price_tip`，`action: status | refresh`，与面板共用同一份数据。 ### 截图展示 ## 安装 本仓库就是插件包本身（`package.json` 里的 `dsh.bundle.patch` 和 `dsh.client`），没有构建步骤，也没有第三方依赖，只用 Node 内置模块。 **从 GitHub 安装** 在 Harness 的插件管理里安装这个 bundle，安装 spec 填： ```text github:jaaaa34/dsh-deepseek-price-tip ``` 也可以让 Agent 调用 `plugin_manager` 的 `install_bundle`，`target` 用同一个 spec。装好后重启 Harness Web UI，输入框下方就会出现胶囊。 **本地开发时直接 link** 在 profile 的 `package.json` 里把依赖指向本目录，并把包名加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`： ```json "@local/deepseek-price-tip": "link:C:/path/to/dsh-deepseek-price-tip" ``` ## 数据与缓存 | 内容 | 位置 | | --- | --- | | 人民币价格、峰时窗口、星期规则 | 首次抓取后写入 `data/pricing-cache.json` | | 内置兜底数据 | `lib/pricing.js` 的 `DEFAULT_PRICING`（2026-10-18 抓取，人民币） | | 中国法定节假日 | 内置 2026 年安排，来源见 `HOLIDAY_SOURCE`；跨年后请用配置补充 | 如果官网表格结构发生大改，解析会失败而不是写入半张表：界面继续显示上一次成功的数据，并提示失败原因。 ## 配置 在 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中给这一行加 `config`： ```yaml - id: deepseek-price-tip name: '@local/deepseek-price-tip' config: autoRefreshHours: 6 # 可选：覆盖峰时窗口，单位是 UTC 零点的分钟数 # peakWindows: [[60, 240], [360, 600]] # 可选：覆盖星期（0 = 周日，6 = 周六） # weekdays: [1, 2, 3, 4, 5] # 可选：追加法定节假日（YYYY-MM-DD） # holidays: ['2027-01-01'] # 可选：换一个抓取地址（英文页会按美元解析并显示 $） # sourceUrl: 'https://api-docs.deepseek.com/quick_start/pricing' ``` `autoRefreshHours: 0` 关闭自动抓取，只保留手动按钮。 ## 验证 ```powershell npm test ``` 也可以单独跑其中一组： ```powershell node test/pricing.test.mjs # 解析、峰谷计算、节假日、缓存校验 node test/host.test.mjs # Host 路由、刷新、失败回退、Agent 工具 node test/client.test.mjs # Client 注册、locale 字典、样式清理 ``` 不需要 `npm install`：测试只用 Node 内置模块（Node 20+）。GitHub Actions 在 Node 20/22/24 上跑同一套测试，见 `.github/workflows/test.yml`。 安装后在 Harness Web UI 里确认：输入框下方出现胶囊；点开有价目表；点“立即更新”后抓取时间变化。浏览器内的实际渲染效果需要在页面中查看，测试只覆盖模块注册和纯逻辑。 ## 限制 - 峰时窗口支持官网中文页的“北京时间 … 为高峰时段”和英文页的 “Peak hours are … UTC” 两种写法；页面改版时可能需要调整解析器。 - 节假日只内置到 2026 年。2027 年及以后，界面会明确提示“未内置该年节假日”，避免把节假日误报成峰价。 - 价格表按官网当前的“模型列 + 峰/谷行”结构解析；Search & Fetch 的按次计费不在模型价目表内。 - 人民币价格直接取自官方中文页，不是按汇率从美元换算。 - 缓存写在插件包目录里的 `data/pricing-cache.json`（已在 `.gitignore` 中忽略）。重新安装或升级插件会让这份缓存丢失，下次刷新时重新抓取，期间用内置的 `DEFAULT_PRICING` 兜底。

plugins.readme_text:
# Reverse Engineering Toolkit — a switchable DSH skill plugin

A DeepSeek Harness **bundle** that registers one model-invocable skill,
`reverse-engineering`, in the profile-global skill layer. Disable the plugin row
(or the whole bundle) in Plugin Manager and the skill disappears from the session
catalog; enable it again and it comes back.

Repository: <https://github.com/MLMLZJ/dsh-reverse-skill>
Index: <https://github.com/MLMLZJ/dsh-plugins>
Companion plugin: <https://github.com/MLMLZJ/dsh-install-profiler> (installation
profiling, dynamic probing, and the handoff brief that feeds this skill).

Inspired by the viral "REA — Reverse Engineer Anything" project
(<https://github.com/morluto/rea>), which popularized agent-driven reverse
engineering after adding Android/APK analysis in October 2026. This plugin is an
independent implementation: it ships instructions plus a local toolchain probe,
not REA's engine or MCP server.

## What it does

- Adds a `skill` catalog entry that the agent loads on demand, then follows to
  classify an artifact, probe installed decompilers, work an authorized target,
  and report evidence-backed findings.
- Bundles `scripts/probe-tools.ps1` (32 tools across Android/Java/.NET/native/
  support, PATH + common install dirs + Android SDK, ~1.5 s, read-only).
- Enforces a blocking authorization gate and an explicit refusal list before any
  tool call, and degrades honestly when a decompiler is missing.

## Install (once)

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/MLMLZJ/dsh-reverse-skill.git C:\Tools\dsh-reverse-skill
```

Then, from a DSH session with Full access or approval:

```
plugin_manager action=install_bundle target=C:\Tools\dsh-reverse-skill
```

The install is a **link**: keep that directory in place, or the plugin breaks.
To update later: `git pull` in that directory, then toggle the row off and on
(the `SKILL.md` body is re-read on activation).

Then confirm the row is active with `plugin_manager list_plugins` (look for
`reverse-skill`) or approval-free `cordis_inspect_query` on the `Config`
provider filtered by `@local/dsh-reverse-skill`.

## On / off

- `plugin_manager action=set_plugin target=reverse-skill enabled=false` — unregisters
  the skill; the next turn receives a replacement catalog without it.
- `enabled=true` — re-registers it (the SKILL.md body is re-read on activation,
  so content edits take effect after a toggle, without restarting DSH).
- `action=remove_bundle target=@local/dsh-reverse-skill` — uninstalls completely.

## Layout

```
package.json              bundle manifest (dsh.bundle.patch)
cordis.patch.yml          inserts row id `reverse-skill`
index.js                  registers the skill via ctx.skills.register()
locale/en.json, zh.json   Plugin Manager title/description
icon.svg                  original icon
skills/reverse-engineering/
  SKILL.md                the instructions the model loads
  references/tool-recipes.md
scripts/probe-tools.ps1   read-only toolchain probe
```

## Safety

The skill refuses DRM/licence/anti-cheat bypass, credential theft, unauthorized
targets, live-service interaction, and redistribution of decompiled material. It
never executes a target on the host; dynamic analysis is limited to a disposable
device/VM the user authorizes. Decompiling a client never reveals server-side
logic — the skill states that limit instead of overselling.

plugins.description: AgentTeams dashboard for the DSH Web UI: teams, token spend (USD/RUB), work time and archive.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-agent-teams-dashboard

A DSH Web plugin that adds a **Teams** section («Команды») to the sidebar and a
dashboard for every AgentTeams chat: active runs and teams finished in the last
three days, token spend with time-range controls, cost in USD and RUB, total and
union work time, team cards with the orca roster and task roadmap, and an
archive for older teams.

The plugin has two halves: a host half (`index.js` + `lib/host/`) that reads DSH
and AgentTeams state read-only and serves two loopback JSON routes, and a
browser half (`lib/client.js`) that renders the panel inside the DSH shell. The
panel never talks to the outside world: it calls its own same-origin route.

![Teams dashboard on a desktop viewport](docs/screenshots/desktop.png)

![Teams dashboard at a 390 px mobile width](docs/screenshots/mobile.png)

Both screenshots come from the offline preview harness with synthetic demo data;
no owner data is used anywhere in this repository.

## Features

- Sidebar section «Команды» (panel id `agent-teams-dashboard`, order 10) with a
  live dot while a team is working.
- Ranges: Today, 7 days (default), 30 days, All time and a custom period picker.
- Three hero cards: tokens (cache / input / output, stacked by day), cost
  (USD primary, RUB always visible, CBR rate with date and stale/override
  markers) and time (total work time plus the merged "online" time).
- Team grid: title that shrinks 13 → 12 → 11 px and clamps to two lines, a
  coloured status dot with a word (active, waiting, halted, stalled, completed,
  unknown), captain and member orca artwork with a monogram fallback, a
  dependency-ordered task roadmap with a segmented progress bar, and a one-line
  metrics footer.
- Archive view with search by title and sorting by end date, title or spend;
  older teams are also reachable from the sticky bottom button.
- Clicking a card or an archive row opens the team chat (the captain session)
  through the shell navigation; a missing session shows a toast instead of
  navigating.
- Skeleton, empty, range-empty, error, stale and partial states; one broken
  `team.json` never blanks the dashboard — it becomes a warning strip while the
  rest stays visible.
- Dark and light themes driven by DSH tokens, keyboard focus, a polite live
  region, reduced motion, and RU/EN dictionaries.

## Install

Requirements: DSH Web with client-plugin support (`dsh.engines.dsh >= 0.2.0-rc.2`)
and, for the data itself, the AgentTeams plugin (`@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams`).

### Install from git (recommended)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add --save-exact git+https://github.com/dadgrand/dsh-agent-teams-dashboard.git#v0.1.0
```

Replace `<profile>` with your DSH profile name (for the Desktop app the default
profile is usually `desktop`). Restart the host when the command finishes; the
loader mounts the plugin's `cordis.patch.yml` row automatically.

### Install from the Desktop plugin manager

Open **Settings → Plugins**, choose "Install from Git URL" and paste:

```text
git+https://github.com/dadgrand/dsh-agent-teams-dashboard.git#v0.1.0
```

Confirm the install and restart the host. The plugin appears in the sidebar as
«Команды».

### Install manually into a profile

Add the dependency to `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>/package.json`:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "dsh-agent-teams-dashboard": "git+https://github.com/dadgrand/dsh-agent-teams-dashboard.git#v0.1.0"
  }
}
```

and the package name to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the same file:

```json
{
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["...", "dsh-agent-teams-dashboard"]
    }
  }
}
```

Then install and restart:

```bash
cd <DSH_HOME>/profiles/<profile>
pnpm install
```

`<DSH_HOME>` defaults to `%USERPROFILE%\\.dsh` on Windows and `~/.dsh` on
macOS/Linux.

## Configuration

Every setting is optional; without a `config` block the plugin mounts with the
defaults below. Override them in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: teams-dashboard
  name: 'dsh-agent-teams-dashboard'
  config:
    archiveDays: 5
    fxEnabled: true
```

| Key | Default | Allowed | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| `stateDir` | `.agent-teams` | non-empty string | AgentTeams state directory inside each workspace. |
| `timeZone` | empty | IANA zone | Zone used for day keys; empty means the host zone. |
| `defaultRange` | `today` | `today`, `7d`, `30d`, `all`, `custom` | Range used when a request carries none (the panel always sends its own; its default is 7 days). |
| `defaultCurrency` | `usd` | `usd`, `rub` | Headline currency when a request carries none. |
| `archiveDays` | `3` | integer 1…365 | Days without activity before a live team moves to the archive (the panel requests 3). |
| `idleGapMs` | `300000` | integer 1000…86400000 | Gap between events that closes an activity interval. |
| `activeWindowMs` | `120000` | integer 1000…86400000 | Window in which a member counts as working. |
| `snapshotTtlMs` | `15000` | integer 0…3600000 | Snapshot cache lifetime. |
| `concurrency` | `8` | integer 1…32 | Parallel file reads while building a snapshot. |
| `maxLogBytes` | `67108864` | integer 65536…1073741824 | Logs larger than this are read from the tail. |
| `fxEnabled` | `true` | boolean | Allow CBR rate fetches; `false` uses the last cache or the baked rate. |
| `fxTtlMs` | `86400000` | integer 60000…2592000000 | Exchange-rate cache lifetime (24 h). |
| `fxFirstWaitMs` | `3500` | integer 0…60000 | How long the first request waits for a rate before using the fallback. |
| `usdRub` | unset | positive number | Manual RUB-per-USD rate; wins over any fetched value. |
| `cnyRub` | unset | positive number | Manual RUB-per-CNY rate; wins over any fetched value. |

The rates can also be supplied through the environment variables
`DSH_TEAMS_DASHBOARD_USD_RUB` and `DSH_TEAMS_DASHBOARD_CNY_RUB`; a manual rate
marks the snapshot as an override.

## Privacy

The plugin is read-only over your DSH home and workspaces:

- `<DSH_HOME>/storages/workspace.json` — the workspace and session registry;
- `<DSH_HOME>/storages/session_projcache/sessions/*.json` — session projections
  (title, token buckets, daily cost, last activity);
- `<DSH_HOME>/sessions/<project>/<session>/session.v4.jsonl.zstd` — session logs
  (activity intervals and the fallback time source);
- `<workspace>/.agent-teams/<team>/team.json` and
  `<workspace>/.agent-teams/archive/<team>/team.json` — roster, tasks, status
  flags.

It never reads message content, never reads the AgentTeams mailboxes
(`inbox/*.jsonl` is out of scope), sends no telemetry and writes exactly one
file: the exchange-rate cache at
`<DSH_HOME>/cache/dsh-teams-dashboard/fx.json`. That file is safe to delete.

The only outbound requests are the two CBR endpoints:

- `https://www.cbr.ru/scripts/XML_daily.asp` (primary);
- `https://www.cbr-xml-daily.ru/daily_json.js` (fallback).

Disable them with `fxEnabled: false`; the plugin then uses the last cached rate
or the baked rate and marks the snapshot as stale. Both panel routes answer only
on loopback (127.0.0.1 / ::1): a remote caller gets `403 forbidden:
loopback-only`. Nothing is sent anywhere else.

The public repository and its fixtures/screenshots contain synthetic demo data
only. `scripts/check-public.mjs` enforces this before every release.

## Compatibility

- DSH Web `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` with client-plugin support (the `dsh.client` bundle
  entry and `sidebar.panellist` / `main` slots).
- Node.js 24 or newer for the test suite, the checks and the offline preview
  harness; the plugin itself has no runtime dependencies.
- AgentTeams (`@nanmicoder/dsh-agent-teams`) is optional to mount but required
  for data: without it the dashboard is empty, and the whale artwork falls back
  to monogram badges.
- Windows, macOS and Linux. Windows paths are handled with `path.join`/`resolve`
  and the same long-path encoding DSH uses.

## Troubleshooting

**The «Команды» row does not appear.** Check that the plugin is in
`dsh.profile.bundles`, that the git spec resolved (look for install errors in
the plugin manager), that the host was restarted, and that the row id
`teams-dashboard` is present in the loader output.

**The panel opens but shows no team

# dsh-bili-fish 🐟 养鱼

给 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh)（DSH）装一只会自己过日子的 AI。

它在设定的时间段里**随机醒一次**，翻一眼你今天的样子，写两篇日记——一篇给你，一篇给它自己。日记不是流水账：它有自己的**好感度**（跨会话不重置）、会随事起伏的**心情**、会饿的**肚子**，还会把写下来的事记进记忆库。

> 主动 @ 那个功能在 [dsh-bili-scroll](https://github.com/lll-77777777/dsh-bili-scroll) 里，这个插件只做「养鱼」。

English: a DSH plugin that gives your assistant a private life — a random daily wake-up, two diaries (one for you, one for itself), plus persistent affection, event-driven mood, hunger, and diary images.

---

## 它每天做什么

1. **生物钟**：在「窗口开始 ~ 结束」之间随机一个时刻醒（不是定点闹钟）。
2. **掷骰子**：默认 30% 概率「今天不想看」——醒一下，记一句为什么摆烂，不写日记。
3. **写两本日记**：素材 = 你自己的 B 站报告 + 当天你和对它说过的话 + 记忆库里记得的事 + 一个小事件：
   - `给主人的信`：有细节、有情绪、称呼你；
   - `自己的日记`：不加滤镜。
4. **结算好感度 + 心情**：模型在末尾追加 `<!--affection:+3|情绪|理由-->` / `<!--mood:pouty|65|为什么-->`，插件剥掉标记、钳制数值、写进 `state.json`。
5. **落盘**：`~/.dsh/bili-fish/diary/<日期>-for-owner.md`、`<日期>-self.md`、`<日期>-week.md`、`cover-<日期>.png`。

素材全空也照写，写一篇「空白日」。

## 快速开始

```bash
# Web / CLI
dsh plugin --profile web add github:lll-77777777/dsh-bili-fish
dsh web
```

**桌面端（Electron）**：桌面窗口读的是 `desktop` profile，命令行 `dsh plugin` 按设计不碰它。在桌面端的会话里直接说：

> 用当前桌面端内置的 `plugin_manager` 装 `dsh-bili-fish`，装完告诉我是否需要重启。

装完完全退出 DSH 再打开。然后 设置 → 养鱼：填一下日记目录、看一眼生物钟窗口，点「现在写一篇」验证。

## ⚠️ 必读：让 headless 能跑

日记是由一个 `dsh --profile headless` 的子会话来写的。**headless profile 默认把模型凭据关掉了**，不改的话子进程会在 5~14 秒内退出，日志里报：

```
dsh: MISSING_CREDENTIAL: llm-deepseek: no API key for provider route "deepseek-official"
```

修法：在 headless profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`（Windows 是 `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\profiles\headless\cordis.patch.yml`）里放开这两项：

```yaml
- id: deepseek-account
  disabled: false
- id: credentials
  disabled: false
```

改完不用重启 DSH，新起的子进程会重新 compose profile。验证：

```bash
DeepSeek\ Harness.exe resources/app.asar/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js headless "Reply with exactly: OK"
```

输出 `OK` 就成了。**这是装完之后「日记永远写不出来」的头号原因。**

## 设置项（设置 → 养鱼）

| 分组 | 项 | 说明 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 生物钟 | 总开关 / 窗口 / 不想看的概率 | 默认 21:00~23:30、30% |
| 日记 | 存到哪 / 写完推微信 / 现在写一篇 | 默认目录 `~/.dsh/bili-fish/diary` |
| 好感度 | 开关 / 每天最多动多少 / 久不聊天会掉 | 默认开、±15、掉好感默认关 |
| 心情 | 开关 / 跟上作息 / 每天换一次 | 事件驱动，见下 |
| 素材 | 刷B站报告 / 工作流水 / 记忆库 / 素材目录 | 四个独立开关；全关写「空白日」 |
| 附加 | 配图 / 周回顾 / 随机小事 / 主动找主人 / 思考带心情 | 默认关、开、开、关、开 |
| 早安 | 开关 / 城市 / 窗口 / 配表情包 | 默认**关**，开了才会推 |
| 喂食 | 饱腹度 / 食物按钮 / 同步小鲸鱼 | 见下 |

## 三个可以玩的部分

**好感度**：初始 50，范围 -100~100，跨会话不重置。分档影响它怎么说话：60+ 会主动黏人、75+ 会翻旧账、85+ 才叫你的名字。日记每天结算一次（受「每天最多动」限制），你也可以在设置页手动 ±。

**心情**：不是一个标签，是一组状态——舒服度（-100~100）、躁动度（0~100）、至多三个成分。由 13 件事推动（被夸、被关心、被凶、被冷落、同一处被反复改、深夜还在干活、饿、阴雨、没睡好、被叫胖……），按人设加权（黏人 0.85、傲娇 0.8、懒 0.7、爱吃 0.6……），关系好坏决定同一件事伤多深，然后随时间往底色回归。

**喂食**：饱腹度 0~100，默认每小时掉 4。白饭最顶饿，辣条/水草/减肥餐会炸。饿了会真的不高兴（心情事件 `hungry`）。三个入口：设置页常驻卡片、右侧边栏 🐟（装了 `dsh-better-sidebar` 才有）、或者直接在聊天里说「喂她一碗白饭」。

## 数据与隐私（请先读）

**都在这台机器上**，但有几处会离开本机，得说清楚：

| 数据 | 在哪 | 会外传吗 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 设置、好感度、心情、肚子 | `~/.dsh/bili-fish/config.json`、`state.json` | 不会 |
| 日记、封面图 | `~/.dsh/bili-fish/diary/`（可改） | 推微信时由你本机的微信插件发出去 |
| 当天你说的话 | 只读 `~/.dsh/sessions/**/*.jsonl.zstd` | **会**：原文作为素材发给模型 |
| 记忆库 | 只读/写 meow-memory 的 SQLite | **会**：检索结果作为素材发给模型 |
| 配图 | 走你配的生图接口 | **会**：日记场景描述发给生图服务 |

所以：**别在会话里说不想让模型知道的东西**（它本来也会看到）；不想要记忆库素材就把那个开关关掉。

## 花费

- 每次写日记 / 早安 = 起一个 headless 会话，大约 **1~2 万 token**（看你素材多少）。
- 心情、好感度、喂食、挂件的同步都是本地计算，不花 token。
- 配图走你自己在 `~/.dsh/agnes-image/config.json` 配的通道，按张计费，失败就跳过、不影响日记。
- 默认**只开**「写日记」，微信推送、配图、早安都要你自己打开。

## 兼容性

- **DSH** ≥ 0.1.7-rc.1；**Node** ≥ 22（用 `node:sqlite` 读记忆库，拿不到就静默降级）。
- **平台**：主要在 **Windows 11 + 桌面版 DSH** 上开发和验证。macOS/Linux 能跑，但通知（Windows toast）会静默降级，`dsh` 可执行文件的探测路径是猜的——找不到就在设置里填 `dshBin`。
- **多实例**：两个 DSH 同时跑会各自 tick、都写 `state.json`，没有加锁。建议只让一个实例开着。
- **依赖漂移**：记忆库是直连 meow-memory 的 SQLite（表名 `fact`/`topic`/`project`）。对方表结构变了会静默降级——不报错，但记忆写不进去。

## 可选依赖

> **推荐配合 [meow-memory](https://github.com/Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-memory) 使用。**
> 装上它，养鱼才有长期记忆，记得你是谁、记得你上次说过什么。
> 不装也能跑，但每次写日记，它都像第一次见你。

| 依赖 | 用来做什么 | 没有会怎样 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| [dsh-bili-scroll](https://github.com/lll-77777777/dsh-bili-scroll) | 每轮把 B 站报告写到 `~/.dsh/bili-duty/out/<日期>.md` | 素材少一块，写「空白日」 |
| [meow-memory](https://github.com/Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-memory) | 记忆库 | 不读也不写记忆 |
| dsh-agnes-image | 日记配图 | 不配图 |
| dsh-wechat-plugin | 把日记推到微信 | 只落盘 |
| dsh-whale-widget | 右下角小鲸鱼：饿了会嘟囔 | 挂件不同步 |
| dsh-better-sidebar | 右侧边栏的 🐟 喂食页 | 用设置页或聊天喂 |

## 给 agent 的工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
| --- | --- |
| `fish_affection` | `get` 读好感度；`adjust` 传 `delta`/`reason`/`mood`（单次 ±15，钳在 -100~100） |
| `fish_mood` | `get` 读心情；`set` 换；`bump` 微调；`event` 注入一件事（见上）；`list` 列出所有心情 |
| `fish_diary` | 读某天的三篇日记（`day` 可省） |
| `fish_feed` | 喂食：传食物 key（`rice`/`fish`/`ramen`…） |

HTTP 接口（给前端/脚本用）：`GET /api/bili-fish/status`、`POST /api/bili-fish/{run,affection,mood,feed,config,diary,morning,unread}`。

## 卸载

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-bili-fish
```

再删掉 `~/.dsh/bili-fish/`（设置、状态、日记、日志都在里面）。桌面端在插件页点「卸载」。

## 开发

```bash
node --check index.js && node --check client.js && node --check lib/*.mjs
```

改完重启 DSH。只改设置字段（`DEFAULTS` + `Config`）保存即生效。

## 版本历史

见 [CHANGELOG.md](./CHANGELOG.md)。

plugins.description: Ctrl+F find bar for the DSH desktop UI: search the conversation and the right panel, highlight matches, and jump between results. As-is / best-effort.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-find-anywhere

为 DeepSeek Harness 桌面版 UI https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness  提供 `Ctrl+F` 式查找：在**当前对话**和**右侧面板**中搜索已渲染文本，高亮全部匹配，并在结果间循环定位。

包名 `@dsh-external/dsh-find-anywhere`，版本 `0.1.0`，纯浏览器实现。

> **发布状态：as-is / best-effort。** 本仓库按现状发布，不承诺持续维护、不承诺跟进上游变更，也不承诺及时响应 issue。详见 [MAINTENANCE.md](MAINTENANCE.md)。

## 为什么值得用：右侧面板内容也能搜

右侧面板常驻文档预览、文件列表、计划/子代理内容等信息。多数查找只覆盖对话正文；本插件把**右侧面板当前激活页里已渲染的文字**纳入同一套查找条：

- 面板打开时，右下角出现圆形 🔍 浮钮，点击即可查找面板内容。
- `Ctrl+Shift+F` 直接进入右侧面板范围。
- 查找条停靠在面板内容区顶部，避开标签栏和文件路径行，并随面板展开/全屏/切换标签重新定位。
- 对话和右侧面板共享高亮、计数、上一个/下一个循环；范围随时切换。

查找条只读取 DOM 文本，不修改面板结构，也不发送内容到网络。

## 使用

| 操作 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `Ctrl+F` / `Cmd+F` | 打开查找条；焦点在右侧面板时搜索面板，否则搜索对话 |
| `Ctrl+Shift+F` | 打开右侧面板范围 |
| 对话标题栏的 🔍 / 右侧面板右下角的 🔍 | 鼠标打开对应范围 |
| 输入文字 | 实时高亮全部匹配，计数显示 `当前/总数` |
| `Enter` / `F3` / `Ctrl+G` | 下一个匹配（循环） |
| `Shift+Enter` / `Shift+F3` / `Ctrl+Shift+G` | 上一个匹配（循环） |
| 计数旁 `↑` / `↓` | 上一个 / 下一个 |
| 查找条左侧的范围切换 | 在对话与右侧面板之间切换 |
| `Esc` | 关闭并清除高亮 |

### 范围规则

- **对话**：搜索当前对话列里已渲染的文字（用户消息、助手回复、工具卡片、命令输出等）；输入框和编辑器被排除，草稿不会产生假匹配。
- **右侧面板**：搜索当前激活页里已渲染的文字（文档预览、文件列表、计划/子代理内容等）；面板标签栏、按钮和工具栏文字被排除。
- 左侧会话列表不参与搜索。
- 面板关闭时，面板入口自动隐藏；面板重新打开或切换标签后，查找条会重新定位。

## 设计取舍

- **不包裹 `<mark>`**：对话 DOM 归 React 所有，流式输出时持续重渲染。插件使用 CSS Custom Highlight API 在 Range 上绘制高亮，不插入节点，不破坏 reconciliation。
- **MutationObserver 跟随流式输出**：对话继续输出或历史分页载入时防抖重算匹配；按“文本节点 + 偏移”保持当前匹配，不会跳到另一个位置。
- **纯 DOM 检索**：不依赖会话数据结构，因此工具卡片、命令输出、折叠内容中已渲染的部分都能被找到；尚未进入 DOM 的虚拟化历史不在范围内。
- **极简外观**：单行 38px 浮条，沿用 `--dsw-alias-*` 主题令牌，自动适配明暗主题；无结果时计数与边框变红并轻微抖动（尊重 `prefers-reduced-motion`）。
- **右侧面板入口**：面板打开时右下角出现圆形 🔍 浮钮；面板关闭时自动隐藏，不占用面板标签栏的槽位。

## 能力边界

- 只匹配渲染后的纯文本：不做正则、不折叠变音符号、不跨文本节点匹配（被样式拆开的短语可能匹配不到）。
- 依赖 CSS Custom Highlight API（当前 Chromium / Electron 均支持）；不支持时仍能计数和滚动定位，但没有高亮底色。
- 虚拟化或懒加载的历史若尚未进入 DOM，需要先滚动加载后再搜索。
- 右侧面板的**浏览器页签**如果是跨域 iframe，父页面无法读取其内部文字；**终端页签**（canvas/xterm）也没有可检索的 DOM 文本。这两类内容搜不到是预期行为。
- 左侧会话列表不参与搜索。
- 若 `Ctrl+Shift+F` 被其他功能占用，用右侧面板右下角的 🔍，或把焦点放进右侧面板后按 `Ctrl+F`。

## 安装与构建

运行时需要支持客户端插件的 DeepSeek Harness Web UI。`lib/` 是注入器实际加载的产物；`src/` 是源码。

```bash
# 仓库是源码形态；先生成运行产物
bash scripts/build.sh
```

若你的环境装有 `dsh-super-injector`，可以把仓库目录注入：

```text
dev_inject_plugin /absolute/path/to/dsh-find-anywhere
```

卸载：

```text
dev_uninject_plugin dsh-find-anywhere
```

也可以直接使用发布包 `dsh-external-dsh-find-anywhere-0.1.0.tgz`。该 tgz 包含 `lib/`、`locale/`、`icon.svg`、`README.md`、`LICENSE` 和 `MAINTENANCE.md`；具体安装方式取决于你的 DSH 版本。

注意：源码仓库的 `.gitignore` 忽略了 `lib/`，所以 GitHub 上的仓库默认是源码形态；需要预构建产物时请使用 tgz，或本地运行构建脚本。

## 隐私与安全

- 不读取会话数据库，不调用后端接口，不发送任何内容到网络。
- 插件在 DSH Web UI 页面内运行，会读取当前页面已渲染的 DOM 文本。安装前请自行审阅源码。
- 查找高亮使用浏览器原生 Highlight API，不向页面插入额外节点。

## 验证状态

本次发布整理只修改了 `package.json` 元数据与文档，没有重新运行 GUI 验证。功能描述基于现有实现，按 as-is 提供；如果上游 UI 结构变化导致失效，本仓库不承诺修复。

## 文件

- `src/client/index.js` — 全部浏览器逻辑与 UI（ModuleLoader bundle 源文件）
- `src/index.js` — Host 注册壳（无 host 行为）
- `scripts/build.mjs` — 无编译依赖的构建（语法校验 + 复制）
- `lib/` — 注入器实际加载的产物（由 `src/` 生成）
- `locale/zh.json`、`locale/en.json` — 插件管理页的标题/描述元数据
- `icon.svg` — 原创图标（对话气泡 + 放大镜）
- `LICENSE` — MIT
- `MAINTENANCE.md` — 维护状态与自维护指引

## License

[MIT](LICENSE) © 2026 dsh-find-anywhere contributors

plugins.description: Transparent draggable performance HUD for DeepSeek Harness - CPU, GPU and memory usage plus CPU/GPU temperatures.
plugins.readme_text:
# dsh-perf-hud

A transparent, draggable performance HUD for the DeepSeek Harness web UI:
**CPU / GPU / memory usage**, plus the **CPU package temperature** when the
optional helper is installed.

![dsh-perf-hud floating over the Harness window](docs/preview.png)

## Highlights

- **Fully transparent** — no card background, no border. Just three rows of text
  floating over the interface, with a soft halo so it stays readable on any
  content.
- **Drag it anywhere.** On release it anchors to the nearest window corner, so
  maximising, restoring or resizing the window keeps it exactly where you put
  it. Double-click resets to the top-right, arrow keys nudge it, and the chevron
  that appears on hover collapses it to a single row.
- **Load-aware colours** — usage turns amber at 70% and red at 90%; temperature
  at 78 °C / 88 °C. Stale readings dim the whole card instead of flashing a fake
  zero.
- **Theme-aware** — only `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, so it follows light, dark and
  any custom theme.
- **Local only** — the metrics route answers loopback, same-origin requests and
  returns 403 for everything else. Nothing is uploaded.

## Requirements

- **Windows 10/11.** The GPU counters, the PowerShell worker and the temperature
  helper are Windows-specific.
- DeepSeek Harness with the web UI.

## Install

From the Plugins page (install from GitHub or a local folder), or:

```sh
dsh plugin add ChendarCe/dsh-perf-hud
```

Then reload the interface once.

## What it reads

| Metric | Source |
| --- | --- |
| CPU usage | `node:os` CPU-time deltas, once a second |
| Memory usage | `os.totalmem()` / `os.freemem()` — same definition as Task Manager's "In use" |
| GPU usage | Windows `GPU Engine` performance counters, busiest engine (what Task Manager reports) |
| CPU temperature | optional helper — LibreHardwareMonitor's `CPU Package` sensor |
| GPU temperature | only when the GPU exposes a temperature sensor; most integrated GPUs do not, so the cell shows `—` |

## Temperatures (optional)

The plugin works out of the box; without the helper both temperature cells show
`—`. For the real CPU package temperature, run **once** (it asks for
administrator rights):

```
helper\setup.cmd
```

That script downloads and sets up:

- **LibreHardwareMonitor 0.9.6** (portable, library only) — reads the sensors;
- **PawnIO 2.2.0**, a signed kernel driver — required to read MSRs while Windows
  "Memory integrity" (HVCI) stays enabled, so you do **not** have to weaken that
  setting;
- **`sensor-helper.ps1`**, which writes one small JSON file about every 0.4 s;
- a scheduled task **`DSH Perf Sensor`** (at logon, highest privileges, no
  window), so it never asks again.

Files go to `D:\DSHTools` when that drive exists, otherwise
`%LOCALAPPDATA%\DSHTools`. The plugin reads either location.

Measured overhead on an 8-core laptop: **0.08 % of one core and ~87 MB of RAM**
for the helper — it is mostly waiting on the driver, not burning CPU.

Remove it again with:

```
helper\uninstall.ps1              # stops the task, uninstalls the driver
helper\uninstall.ps1 -RemoveFiles # ...and deletes the helper files
```

## Limitations

- Windows only.
- GPU temperatures need a dedicated sensor; Intel integrated GPUs do not expose
  one, and the CPU package temperature is the closest reference (same die).
- The card floats **inside the Harness window**, not as a separate
  always-on-top desktop window.

## 中文说明

DeepSeek Harness 界面里的一块完全透明的性能读数：CPU / GPU / 内存占用率，加上
CPU 封装温度。没有底色和边框，只有三行文字浮在界面上。

- **拖动**卡片任意位置移动，松手后吸附到最近的窗口角，窗口最大化 / 还原 / 改变
  大小都保持位置；**双击**回到右上角，方向键微调，悬停右侧箭头可收起成一行。
- 占用率 ≥70% 变琥珀、≥90% 变红；温度 ≥78 °C / ≥88 °C 同理；读数过期整卡变暗。
- 安装：插件页面安装本仓库，或 `dsh plugin add ChendarCe/dsh-perf-hud`。
- 温度需要可选助手：管理员运行一次 `helper\setup.cmd`（会安装 LibreHardwareMonitor
  与 PawnIO 签名驱动，并注册开机自启任务）。不需要时用 `helper\uninstall.ps1` 移除。
- 没有温度助手时温度一栏显示 `—`；Intel 核显本身没有独立温度传感器，同样显示 `—`。
- 仅支持 Windows；悬浮窗在 Harness 窗口内部，不是独立的桌面置顶窗口。

## License
